says: National list of threatened mammals; toninha listed.
Updated the annexes of Portarias 443, 444 and 445/2014; toninha kept as Critically Endangered.
verification: Secondary (official PDF no longer at the cited address)

says: Current national list: “Mamíferos Mammalia Artiodactyla Pontoporiidae Pontoporia blainvillei CR”.
Approves the 1st cycle of the PAN Toninha (2010–2015): avoid population decline between Espírito Santo and Rio Grande do Sul; seven goals.

Approves the 2nd cycle: “evitar o declínio populacional da toninha em todas as áreas de manejo”, with eight specific objectives (bycatch in gillnets, shared fisheries management, habitat, critical areas, awareness, policy integration, data, research by FMA).
status: Expired (Sep 2024); no 3rd cycle published on the ICMBio page

says: Creates the Parque Nacional do Albardão (about 1,004,480 ha) and the APA do Albardão (Santa Vitória do Palmar, RS). The ICMBio announcement names the toninha as the leading threatened species protected.
status: In force; challenged by PDL 112/2026 in the Senate
verification: Announcement read; decree text not retrieved

says: Gillnet rules for SE and S Brazil (closed season 15 Jul–15 Oct in Área 1; no motorised gillnetting within 1 nautical mile). Often cited as the main bycatch-relevant rule for the toninha; whether its text names the species was not verified.
São Paulo fauna list: “Pontoporia blainvillei (Gervais & d’Orbogny, 1844) toninha EN”.
Rio Grande do Sul list of threatened fauna; toninha listed as CR (the 2002 list, Decreto 41.672, had it as VU).
Espírito Santo list of threatened fauna; toninha listed as “Em Perigo” (IEMA).

Approves the National Action Plan to reduce interactions of marine mammals with fisheries; the plan has a section “Captura incidental de franciscana” (observer data from Bahía Samborombón–San Clemente del Tuyú and Cabo San Antonio). The resolution text itself does not name the species.
National classification of native mammals: “Pontoporiidae 201 Pontoporia blainvillei Franciscana Amenazada”. Repeals Resolución 1030/2004.
category: Amenazada (VU A3cd in the SAREM 2019 categorisation)

says: “Se declara al Delfín Franciscana (Pontoporia blainvillei) especie protegida en la Provincia de Río Negro.” Prohibits hunting, capture, harassment and any action that harms the species or its habitat.
“Declárase Monumento Natural a la ‘Franciscana’ o ‘Delfín de Río’ (Pontoporia blainvillei), en todo el ámbito de la Provincia de Buenos Aires.” To be regulated under Ley 10.907.

instrument: Plan Sectorial “Sistema Departamental de Áreas Protegidas” (Resolución 14/00753)
says: Names the “franciscana”, Pontoporia blainvillei, among four species of genetic interest that “precisan de medidas de manejo y protección”.

instrument: Priority species for the SNAP (Soutullo et al. 2013)
kind: Technical priority list (not a legal act)
says: Listed as “Especie prioritaria SNAP amenazada”; no decree or law naming the franciscana was found.
verification: Secondary (Ministerio de Ambiente species sheet, search result)

says: The franciscana is listed in Appendices I and II of the Convention on Migratory Species (Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay are Parties).
Joint action of Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay; renewed for 2026–2029.
